structured.answer: I'm not choosing today. If I had to, I'd lean towards הראל because it's a big name I know and its fees were the lowest I saw, but I didn't find a track I'm sure is as safe as my deposits, so I'll ask my son or the bank first.

stuck.why: Full of names I don't know (S&P 500, עוקב מדדים, כספי (שקלי), גמיש). Only "אג"ח ממשלתי" sounded safe, and I never found its row on the screens I read.
Instead of returns they say "פחות מ־3 שנים", so there was nothing to judge them by.

stuck.where: The circle pictures next to מניות/מט"ח
stuck.why: I couldn't tell what they show or what מט"ח 99% means.
Tired after six screens of numbers on a black background, so I stopped.

used: The title "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and the "קופת גמל להשקעה" button
The company headings with their fee ranges: הראל, מור, אנליסט, מיטב
The track names and the 3-year and 5-year returns in rows from הראל, מור, אנליסט and מיטב
skimmed: Rows of מור, אנליסט and מיטב
skipped: מדריך and השקעה במדד menu items
Arrow links at the end of each row
not_found: A plain sentence saying which track is safe, like a deposit
The government bond (אג"ח ממשלתי) track rows

findings.what: No sentence says which tracks are low-risk; safe-sounding options are hidden behind unfamiliar names and English letters
Dark background with small grey text, especially the column headings, is hard to read even enlarged
Every row repeats the same labels (מניות/מט"ח, מההחיסכון/מההפקדה, 3 שנים/5 שנים), making me re-read them on each row
Circle charts use two close colours whose numbers sit beside them, so I had to look back and forth
Many rows show "פחות מ־3 שנים" instead of returns, so the safer bond tracks have nothing to compare
Large share returns (24%, 26%) stand out and draw the eye, but the risk behind them isn't explained
Unclear marks like "עוד לא דווח" with an orange icon and "101%" shares
I don't know the site "מקור" or who is behind it
